initiative.title: The Verse engine: what the worlds need next
initiative.body: Engine upgrades that worlds built on the Verse are waiting for. Each task names the projects and tasks that need it.

milestones.title: What Planetary Villa needs from the engine
milestones.body: Upgrades Hecate's Cemetery is blocked on; each links back to its Planetary Villa tasks.

tasks.title: Night lighting: moonlight as the key light, soft shadows
tasks.body:
A night lighting model for realms: one moonlight key light, dim ambient, soft shadows, and tone mapping that keeps dark scenes readable.

Needed by Planetary Villa (https://openagents.com/projects/planetary-villa): hc-moonlight. Those tasks wait on this one.
acceptance: Works in a realm on openagents.com at desktop and phone, inside the frame budget
coax test passes on the engine files touched
A short demo in /realm shows it

tasks.title: Four-legged characters: rig, gaits and customizable shape
tasks.body:
A quadruped rig with walk, trot, run, sit, lie, dig and pick-up motions, and shape parameters (size, proportions, ears, tail, coat colours and pattern) that an agent or a slider can set.

Needed by Planetary Villa (https://openagents.com/projects/planetary-villa): hc-pet-customize, hc-fetch. Those tasks wait on this one.
